item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.8] CVE-2026-6859 - Redhat instructlab, Redhat enterprise linux ai
item.description: A flaw was found in InstructLab. The `linux_train.py` script hardcodes `trust_remote_code=True` when loading models from HuggingFace. This vulnerability can lead to complete system compromise.
